The '''Imperial College of Priests''' was a priestly and ceremonial body of the [[Imperial Cult]]. It supported major rites, helped train religious officials, and formed part of the institutional network around the [[Great Temple of Vespera]] and the [[Imperial Religious Academy]].

The college appears in source material as an assisting body during imperial ceremonies. This draft keeps the institution broad until more source-backed detail is available.
